rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a change or transformation, including a marked improvement when the context makes that clear.

example.english: This community has undergone a major transformation in just a few years, making residents’ lives much more convenient.
example.traditional: 呢個社區幾年內有好大改變，居民生活方便咗好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 se5 keoi1 gei2 nin4 noi6 jau5 hou2 daai6 goi2 bin3 geoi1 man4 sang1 wut6 fong1 bin6 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for the conversion or switching of one format, system, state, or function into another rather than for a general change.

example.english: This program can perform the transformation of a text file into an image file.
example.traditional: 呢個程式可以將文字檔轉換成圖片檔。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 cing4 sik1 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 man4 zi6 dong2 zyun2 wun6 sing4 tou4 pin3 dong2

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase for a striking makeover or improvement in someone's appearance or character.

example.english: After the haircut, the transformation was so striking that his friends almost didn’t recognise him.
example.traditional: 佢剪完頭髮，成個人大變身，朋友差啲認唔出。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zin2 jyun4 tau4 faat3 seng4 go3 jan4 daai6 bin3 san1 pang4 jau5 caa1 di1 jing6 m4 ceot1
